verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect documents API-driven onboarding, connected-account creation, and an official MCP server, so the core seller operations are reachable programmatically. Several parts of the story are not evidenced, and the MCP server is not shown to expose Connect account operations. missing for 10: evidence of handling requirements-due/currently_due states via API, scoped or restricted credentials for agents, MCP tools specifically covering Connect account creation and onboarding, independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven onboarding to completion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can run seller operations — create accounts, drive onboarding to completion, and answer requirements-due states through the API or an MCP surface with scoped credentials

citations.quote: API onboarding: You use the Stripe API to build your own customized onboarding UI.
Create a unified identity to represent each of your platform's connected accounts with one or more configurations, such as merchant or customer.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.stripe.com/mcp
test your Connect integration for account creation, identity verification, and payouts.
